title: EC 1.2.7: PCA of Conjoint triad
caption: PCA projection of all 550 proteins in the EC 1.2.7 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: -0.06. The first two components explain 10.6% and 5.2% of variance. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
